rationale: A both reacts appropriately to inputs (TOUCH, CALL, OFFER_FOOD, STARTLE) and initiates sensible shifts without prompts (e.g., to FOOD_TROUGH at 18, PLAY_CHIME at 30, SEALED_GATE at 42, and PLAY_BOW toward PLAY_BALL at 78), then recovers from the buzzer by re-engaging in play. B responds to TOUCH, OFFER_FOOD, and STARTLE, but from 40 onward mostly maintains attention=NONE despite PRESENT_OBJECT:PLAY_BALL at 44 and shows long, unvarying states with fewer purposeful, experience-linked changes. Thus A shows greater autonomy, coherence, adaptation, and lifelike spontaneity.
